ai_language_tip: 索馬利亞語、蒂格利尼亞語不在清單。預設可用阿拉伯語；索馬利亞城市商務也常改英語，吉布地行政場合法語很強，厄利垂亞英語也常見。對方改用哪一種支援語言就跟著說。
english_ok: sometimes — 摩加迪休、哈爾格薩部分旅館與 NGO 相關場合英語較通；吉布地以法語、阿拉伯語為主；厄利垂亞公務英語與提格雷尼亞語並用，但後者不在支援清單。
politeness: 阿拉伯語用 السيد／السيدة 與正式稱呼；英語用 Sir／Madam；法語用 vous。先問候再辦正事。不要用過短的命令句。
name_tip: 報名加父名或姓（如 Ahmed Hassan、Amina Farah）；拼法先跟對方已寫的拉丁或阿拉伯字母，再逐字確認。
phone_tip: 索馬利亞手機常見 61 等開頭（61 123 4567），國際冠碼 +252。厄利垂亞 +291、吉布地 +253（吉布地手機常見 77 開頭）。朗讀分組。WhatsApp 是最常見的確認渠道。
time_tip: 書面可用 24 小時；口語常配合禮拜時間（بعد صلاة المغرب），仍要再問鐘點。吉布地、摩加迪休晚餐多在 19:00 之後。
number_tip: 索馬利亞商務常提到 EVC Plus（Hormuud）或 ZAAD，不要自動套到厄利垂亞或吉布地。金額先問對方用哪一種先令、法郎或美元計價。
avoid_calling: 避開週五中午禮拜、日落禮拜前後的用餐高峰，以及中午最熱的時段打給小店；厄利垂亞公務窗口多在上午。夜間少打給機關。
closed_days: 開齋節、古爾邦節在三國都重要。吉布地另有獨立日等法國曆與伊斯蘭曆並用的假期。厄利垂亞還有自己的獨立日與基督教節日，不要用同一張假期表套三國。
booking_channels: 旅館與餐廳幾乎都靠 WhatsApp 或電話，較大旅館（如吉布地的國際品牌）可用官網或大型訂房網站。沒有可驗證的區域級訂桌 App。索馬利亞付款常見 EVC Plus。
voice_menu: Hormuud 等大型電信與部分銀行可能有簡短語音；多數旅館櫃檯與餐館仍人工接聽，線路品質不穩時會改用 WhatsApp。
callback_habits: 幾乎都用 WhatsApp 文字確認；國際旅館才會發電郵。不要假設有簡訊系統。

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 摩加迪休、哈爾格薩、吉布地餐廳多半 WhatsApp 或電話留桌，沒有可驗證的區域訂位平台；先問收 EVC、現金還是卡。
usually_asked: Date and hour, including whether it is after evening prayer
Party size and whether a family section is preferred
Name and a local mobile or WhatsApp number
Payment: EVC Plus in much of Somalia, cash or card in a hotel restaurant in Djibouti

may_come_up.what: A hotel restaurant in Djibouti may prefer a booking through the front desk
The dining area is separated and the host wants the party type stated

sensitive_asked.what: An EVC or ZAAD payment is demanded to an unlabelled personal number before any confirmation

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 診所多半打電話或 WhatsApp 問當天能不能看，公立機構常要到場；要說明看哪一科、帶哪種證件。
usually_asked: First visit or follow-up and the specialty
Patient name as on an ID or passport
Morning or afternoon and a callback number

may_come_up.what: A public facility may only take names in person in the morning

sensitive_asked.what: A third party is asked to recite a full medical history on the call

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 沙龍用 WhatsApp 約時間最常見，電話能通也會被轉去傳說明。
usually_asked: Hair, henna or barber work and a rough duration
Day and hour and a second choice
The WhatsApp number for the reminder

may_come_up.what: A stylist works from a private home and is known by a first name

sensitive_asked.what: Identity photos are demanded in a private chat before any time is noted

repair.before_dialing_zh: 維修先 WhatsApp 傳照片再約到店；零件供應不穩定時，先問能不能修、大概何時取件。
usually_asked: What failed and the make if known
Leave the item at the workshop versus a visit
When someone can hand it over

may_come_up.what: A part may be hard to source and the delay is unclear

sensitive_asked.what: A remote fee to a personal EVC number is demanded before the item is seen

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 外帶直接 WhatsApp 或打電話點，沒有可驗證的大型外送平台；要說清取餐時間與門址。
usually_asked: Dishes and quantities
Collection time or a simple drop-off in a named district
A number that will answer at the gate or hotel entrance

may_come_up.what: Delivery may be possible only inside a short list of neighbourhoods

sensitive_asked.what: Payment is redirected to a different personal EVC number than the shop named

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 商店留貨靠 WhatsApp 問存貨，電話只確認還有沒有貨與何時可取。
usually_asked: The exact item and quantity
Collect in store or a short local drop-off
Name to put on the reserved goods

may_come_up.what: Stock may have to come from another city or from Djibouti port

sensitive_asked.what: Full prepayment to a private EVC number is required before they confirm stock

change.before_dialing_zh: 改期回原 WhatsApp 或再打給同一間店，報名字與原時間；國際旅館才有訂單編號。
usually_asked: Original date, hour and the name
The new time or a cancellation
A new headcount if it changes

may_come_up.what: A hotel may treat a late change under its own desk rule

sensitive_asked.what: An extra EVC payment is demanded only to change the hour

inquiry.before_dialing_zh: 問營業時間或收哪一種錢包，直接打或傳 WhatsApp 最準，因為許多店沒有網頁。
usually_asked: The concrete question (hours, EVC or cash, a dish, a spare part)
The day they plan to visit
A number if the answer will come later by WhatsApp

may_come_up.what: EVC Plus and ZAAD should not be assumed in Eritrea or in every Djibouti shop

sensitive_asked.what: Someone asks the owner to read a wallet PIN or one-time code aloud

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 吉布地國際品牌可用官網或大型訂房網站；索馬利亞與厄利垂亞多數旅館用 WhatsApp 問空房，入住常要出示護照。
usually_asked: Check-in and check-out dates and how many guests
Room type and whether breakfast is included
Name as on the passport and a WhatsApp number

may_come_up.what: A written confirmation may arrive only as a WhatsApp message

sensitive_asked.what: A passport scan and a transfer to a personal wallet are demanded before any confirmation

activity.before_dialing_zh: 短程行程多經旅館或導遊 WhatsApp 安排，團員不足或安全狀況變化時可能改期。
usually_asked: Which outing and the date, with an alternative day
Number of people and the meeting point
A local mobile

may_come_up.what: The operator leaves only if enough guests join, or may postpone for local conditions

sensitive_asked.what: Full prepayment to an unnamed personal wallet is required with no receipt

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 維修與清潔靠 WhatsApp 約上門，地址要講清區名、複合院落與門房怎麼放行。
usually_asked: The job and a visit window
District and how the technician is let in
A number that will answer at the gate

may_come_up.what: The technician quotes only after a photo on WhatsApp

sensitive_asked.what: A door code and a remote EVC payment are demanded before any visit

pet.before_dialing_zh: 獸醫服務有限，通常先 WhatsApp 或電話問當天能不能看，不要假設有線上掛號。
usually_asked: Species and the reason for the visit
Whether it can be seen the same day
Owner name and a mobile

may_come_up.what: A clinic may only see animals in the morning, if at all that day

sensitive_asked.what: A personal transfer is demanded to reserve a kennel with no clinic name

tracking.before_dialing_zh: 海運經吉布地或空運到貨後，常要打電話給代理行；單號加上航班或船舶名稱較有用。
usually_asked: The reference and whether it is air or sea freight
Name on the consignment and a local contact
Collection in Djibouti, Hargeisa, Mogadishu or Asmara

may_come_up.what: A cash charge may be due at the agent's office before release

sensitive_asked.what: A wallet top-up is requested to release a parcel that cannot be identified

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 電信（如 Hormuud 與 EVC Plus）與銀行以電話或 WhatsApp 為主；不要在通話或訊息裡報錢包密碼。
usually_asked: Which operator or bank and the account or wallet label
The issue in one sentence
The name on the contract and a callback number

may_come_up.what: They may ask the customer to visit an office with an identity document

sensitive_asked.what: Anyone asks for an EVC PIN, ZAAD PIN or one-time code on the call

transport.before_dialing_zh: 叫車多靠旅館代叫、WhatsApp 約司機或街邊的士，沒有可驗證的大規模叫車 App 覆蓋；機場接送最好提前約。
usually_asked: Pickup and drop-off (hotel, airport, district) and the time
Passengers and bags
A number the driver can call

may_come_up.what: The hotel desk may prefer to send a known driver rather than a random taxi

sensitive_asked.what: A driver asks for the full fare to a personal EVC number before sharing any plate

property.before_dialing_zh: 看房經仲介或熟人 WhatsApp 約，可能被要求先出示證件；地址用區名與地標。
usually_asked: Viewing time and rent or sale
Name and a number at the gate
Budget currency if asked

may_come_up.what: The agent wants to see an identity document before opening

sensitive_asked.what: A reservation fee to a personal wallet is demanded before any visit

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 公務窗口與學校多要本人到場，電話只能問文件與受理時間；吉布地用法語較順，其他地方可用阿拉伯語或英語。
usually_asked: Which office or school and the purpose
The person's name as on the official document
Whether a number is issued only in person

may_come_up.what: Many counters are morning-only or close around Friday prayer

sensitive_asked.what: A caller claiming to be from an office asks for a personal wallet payment to speed up a file
